To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The majority of cancer survivors report unmet information needs, 2) the most common needs relate to the cancer experience, 3) survivors want information about cancer recurrence, 4) survivors want information in a format and from a source they can understand, and 5) survivors want to be able to access information in a convenient way.
the majority of the participants were aware of the importance of the use of protective clothing and that there were some barriers to the use of these protective measures.
